# Module: ui-core (logical, inside `app`)

<!-- Generated by sdlc-context, then reviewed by a human. Keep under ~120 lines. -->

## Purpose

UI infrastructure shared by rendering, Struts2 and web services: servlet filters, `RollerContext`/`RollerSession` listeners, Spring Security glue, UI plugin manager, calendar tag models, JSP tag support. Merges `weblogger/ui/core` and the tiny `weblogger/ui/tags`.

- Main (51 files): `app/src/main/java/org/apache/roller/weblogger/ui/core` (47: `filters` 14, `security` 10, `plugins` 6, `tags/calendar` 5, `util/menu` 8, root 4) and `weblogger/ui/tags` (4) [verified: find count]
- Test (10 files): `app/src/test/java/org/apache/roller/weblogger/ui/core` (7) plus three package-root tests `weblogger/ui/{ApplicationResourcesTest,EntryEditorAssetsTest,UIPluginManagerTest}.java` [verified: find count]; assignment of those three to ui-core is a judgement call (`UIPluginManagerTest` imports `ui.core.plugins.UIPluginManager`; the other two import no roller classes)
